objectives.title: Prison Camps
objectives.description: Capture the enemy Prison Camp to summon your Cavalry. Camps can be retaken by Heroes and Minions, so guard them well!

objectives.title: Cavalry
objectives.description: Cavalry soldiers charge down each lane when summoned granting increased damage and movement speed to nearby Allied Heroes.

objectives.title: Generals
objectives.description: Each team’s Core has been replaced by a General who fights against attacking enemies. Destroying a Keep reduces the General’s Armor.
